question: Select the correct pair of personalities who are the recipients of the Padma Shri Award 2022 in Science and Engineering.

options.text: Dr. Lata Desai and Basanti Devi

solution:

__
 
• The correct pair of recipients of the Padma Shri Award 2022 in the field of Science and Engineering is 
 
 
• **Sanghamitra Bandyopadhyay and Subbanna Ayyappan.**
 
 
 
• **Sanghamitra Bandyopadhyay** is a renowned Indian computer scientist and director of the Indian Statistical Institute.
 
 
• She has made significant contributions in the field of computational biology and machine learning.
 
 
 
• **Subbanna Ayyappan** is an agricultural scientist and former director-general of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR).
 
 
• He has contributed to the development of agricultural technologies and fisheries research in India.
